phase: 5c2-prep-c3a — the pre-filter census of the post leg
asks: how many of the window's posts the relevance pre-filter passes, and what they cost
decides_nothing: the pre-registration (prep-c3b) pins the number; this file only counts it. Nothing is fetched, nothing is spent, and no row is asked of any model

anchor.rule: since <= date < until, half-open, so the window is exactly 28 days
anchor.why: ratified by SPEC 3.18 (7)(a) — the corpus's own last day + 1. The two alternatives priced beside it in results/census_5c2.json were seen and declined

rule: The text leg's sample frame: which corpus rows the position pre-filter passes ($0, offline).

instrument.prefilter: market_pulse.positions.prefilter — a watchlist brand or a tracked category term AND a size/price pattern, both on the SAME line
instrument.not_the_entry_gate: 3.18 (7)(e) is explicit: «never the channel entry gate of 3.12, which gates CHANNELS». This filter gates ROWS and every registry channel is screened
instrument.same_code_as_the_pass: scripts/run_loop.py :: posts_of calls the same positions.prefilter over the same two files, so the population counted here is the queue that pass would answer

selection_pin.asks: is this the window the operator ratified, or another one with the same dates
selection_pin.why: the row COUNT can match while the rows differ — a store that moved under a later re-run produces the same total from different posts. The hash is what catches it

negative :: a fitness post with a discou.line: Розклад тренувань на тиждень: понеділок — ноги, середа — спина, п'ятниця — руки. Реєстрація за посиланням, знижка 20% до кінця місяця.
negative :: a fitness post with a discou.expected: does not pass — the rule is a conjunction

negative :: a category with no number be.expected: does not pass — the rule is a conjunction

negative :: a price with no category and.expected: does not pass — the rule is a conjunction

totals.carrying_note: rows, not matches, and the three are not exclusive. `currency` is the cheapest deterministic reading of «is this line priced at all» — the filter cannot tell an OFFER from a recipe, and «Кефір — 400 мл» is a category term beside a size in an ingredient list. `percent` is its own bucket because «82,5%» is a fat content and «-38%» is a discount, and nothing here can tell them apart

frame.ids_sha256_note: sha256 of the passing ids, newline-joined in this record's order — sku_prefilter_census's own convention, so prep-c3b can pin the draw
frame.evidence: every row below carries the LINE that fired, the term that matched and the size/price pattern beside it, which is the frame convention 3.18 (7)(e) names

rate.why: the settled serverless rate — the one field every projection in this repo has used since sku-b, and the one results/projection_5c2.json prices both other legs with

derivation.source: results/sku_b_positions_skub2.json :: derived, no single field holds it
derivation.how: write_sku_projection_b2.text_marginal, the house derivation reused rather than rewritten: (timing.worker_seconds - projection.opened_seconds - pages x page_marginal) / population.text_rows
derivation.why: skub2's own text leg — 30 rows, on the serverless runtime, PAID

report_line.quote: text leg    84.398 s over  30 rows  = 2.8133 s/row    $0.0259
report_line.why: the same leg in that session's report. It reads 2.8133 against the 2.8132 derived here — a fourth-decimal rounding difference, not two measurements

fixed_seconds.boot: NOT added: 3.18 (7)(c) buys the two-leg window in ONE session, and this leg rides the endpoint the leaflet leg already booted. A boot here would be double-counted against results/projection_5c2.json, which already pays one

leaflet_corpus.asks: the whole leaflet corpus on disk — 3.18 (7)(d), NOT intersected with the window

ruling.why: SPEC 3.18 (7)(d) states the population; the numbers beside it are re-counted from the manifest here, so the clause and the file agree or this record shows they do not

leaflet_corpus.why_not_window_intersected: «leaflets follow their own weekly cadence, and the window clause of (4) binds the comment and post legs only» — 3.18 (7)(d). The window holds 78 of these 159 pages (results/census_5c2.json :: totals.leaflet_pages_in_window) and the leg buys all 159

cannot_answer.why: no file in data/raw/posts/ — the channel has never been walked. NOT zero
